_doc: The Vos Syndicate's fighters (mockup 37): the Cutter (the standard fighter) and the Twin boom (the shuttle stand-in and bomber). Each unwrapped and baked onto its own UVs by tools/blender/painted_bake.py --ship (never edited by hand): the UV mesh in ship space (+x port, +y up, +z bow, metres) and its painted colour, AO and glow maps. uv_m is metres of hull per UV unit.
